inputs.value: Failed: no job found for JobNumber '@{triggerOutputs()?['body/JobNumber']}' (expected exactly 1 match, found @{length(outputs('Get_job')?['body/value'])}).

inputs.name: result
inputs.value: Failed: no sub-phase with Sequence @{triggerOutputs()?['body/FromSequence']} in job @{triggerOutputs()?['body/JobNumber']}.

Compose_conflict_summary.inputs:
@if(equals(length(variables('conflicts')), 0), '', concat('

Crew conflicts detected: ', string(length(variables('conflicts'))), '

', join(variables('conflicts'), ''), '
CrewSub-phaseDatesOverlapsConflicting job / sub-phase
'))

Compose_success_result.inputs: @concat('Reflow complete for ', triggerOutputs()?['body/JobNumber'], '. ', string(variables('moved')), ' sub-phase(s) moved. Skipped: ', if(equals(variables('skipped'), ''), 'none', variables('skipped')), '. New pool finish: ', if(equals(variables('poolFinish'), ''), 'unchanged', variables('poolFinish')), '. ', string(variables('pastCount')), ' sub-phase(s) now scheduled before today.', ' Crew conflicts: ', string(length(variables('conflicts'))), '.', outputs('Compose_conflict_summary'))

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: @{if(empty(coalesce(first(outputs('Get_job')?['body/value'])?['ProjectManager']?['Email'], '')), '[no PM email] ', '')}ALERT: crew conflict after reschedule - @{triggerOutputs()?['body/JobNumber']}

Compose_failure_message.inputs: @concat('Failed: unexpected error while reflowing job ', triggerOutputs()?['body/JobNumber'], '. Check the flow run history for details.')
